title: Capstone: The Relief Drone
prompt:
**Bài toán.** A relief drone flies from the top-left cell to the
bottom-right cell of an n×n grid of supply values, moving only right or
down. It collects the value of every cell it enters. Its cargo bay can
**discard exactly one cell's haul** along the way (turn one entered cell's
value into 0; at most once per trip, optional). Maximize the collected
total; print it.

**Constraints:** 2 ≤ n ≤ 300; −100 ≤ grid[i][j] ≤ 100.

**Input:** line 1: n; then n lines of n values.
**Output:** one integer.

tests.name: sample
tests.hint: Inner route 10→30→40→50→60 = 190 — no discard needed there. (Subtracting the GLOBAL −50 invents 240.)

tests.name: all positive
tests.hint: Best plain path 1→3→4 = 8; the optional discard is worthless here.

tests.name: off-path min
tests.hint: The best path avoids -9 entirely: plain path sum 5, nothing worth discarding → 5. A solution that subtracts the GLOBAL minimum invents a 14.
